title: curtain rod with hardware
text:
curtain rod with hardware. UPDATE BELOW: Purchased this to hand some curtains that I was using while I wait for my new mini blinds. This rod is adjustable and comes with the hardware to hang it. The end tips twist on and off. I didn't need to take them off to hang my curtains as the holes were plenty big enough to slide through with the tips on. It is a brushed nickel which is nice- not shiny. Very functional.
UPDATE 10/2/2021 - I have since purchased 3 more of these rods. They are just really simple and functional. Not super fancy or sporty - but I really love the brushed silver metal and the simple rounded, small heads for the tips. I am still very happy with my purchase
